initialization: Original pretrained residual block and corresponding seed's frozen-head checkpoint from head-v1
frozen_modules: Detector, numbering and grading prefix through layer4.1
batch_normalization: Running means/variances frozen in all layers; affine parameters trainable only in layer4.2
activation_cache: Float32 input of layer4.2 computed once from the exact automatically extracted original ROI; no augmentation
class_weights: Inverse square root of assessed training counts, normalized to mean 1; same rule as frozen-head v1
selection: Within each seed, strictly highest validation macro-F1 over labels [0,1,2], earliest epoch on ties; include the initial warm-start checkpoint as epoch 0

heldout_test.unlock_condition: All six checkpoints and protocol hashes fixed in an immutable selection manifest before downloading or processing test MRI
heldout_test.primary_metric: Macro-F1 on the identical assessed test ROI subset; labels [0,1,2]
other_metrics: coverage overall and by reference class
all-seed mean and sample standard deviation
heldout_test.timing: Common DICOM/localization/ROI processing separately from classifier inference; same device, batch size, warm-up and synchronization for model comparison
